text:
Aisha: quick check — PR #21088 (small db index change) is ready to land. CI is slow today but green on unit tests. can we squeeze this into the pre-freeze window? @Ben @Dina :eyes:
Ben: do we need a rebase or is it just CI flake? link?
Aisha: looks like a flaky integration on mac and windows e2e. no code changes since last CI, so likely transient. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/21088
merge-bot: CI update: e2e-matrix queued (run id 98765) — estimated ETA ~20m
Dina: saw a windows-specific timeout in the last run: "Timeout while waiting for migration to finish". small flake but consistent 1/6 runs.
Chris: if it's just that timeout we can rerun the single job instead of whole matrix. use `/ci retry job 98765 e2e-windows`
Aisha: thanks. can someone trigger that? i'm on calls for next 40m. cc @Ben
Ben: I can kick it. also happy to rebase if merge conflict shows up.
ops-oncall: reminder — deploy freeze starts in 3h (21:00 UTC). if this lands, we should avoid any canary that touches schema migrations after 20:30 UTC.
Aisha: good call. this is a no-downtime index add but wants to be conservative. if windows passes and we get approvals we can merge >1h before freeze?
Dina: rerun started: `/ci retry job 98765 e2e-windows` -> job 98766
merge-bot: CI update: e2e-windows passed (job 98766). all jobs green.
Ben: quick review left — two tiny nits but not blocking. i'll approve once addressed, or i can approve and file follow-up nits. which do you prefer @Aisha?
Aisha: please approve and file nits. want to get this into the queue before any backpressure.
Ben: approved. :white_check_mark:
Chris: merging plan? do we want a canary in staging first or bypass canary for this small change?
Aisha: let's do a light canary in staging (10% traffic) and watch logs for 30m, then full if OK. will monitor and be available by phone.
ops-oncall: noted. i'll hold the freeze exception if prod canary is limited and no errors in 30m.
merge-bot: PR #21088 merged by Ben at 1769994567.
Aisha: thanks all :heart: — filing a short post-merge note in release notes channel and closing the loop.
